strongest_objection: The map's changed question, that what is legible in an afternoon was made legible for an outside judge, is not applied to the map's own showcase cases. The sterile cockpit is a regulator's rule written after wrecks, and the item that opens with it closes by saying no manual lists what is not funny; the refinery's parts per million of sulphur is the fuel regulation's precision, offered as the domain's; the newspaper that cut the newsroom before the presses is the item's own lie case (presses under contract, trucks under lease) presented as a confession; the underwriter's form is said to read what kills enterprises when it reads what has produced paid claims, which for a law firm is missed deadlines and not the partner who walks with the clients. None of these breaks the mechanism, and I could not collapse any two items or produce a nonmember that the type admits, but the cases must be re-sorted into the columns the map itself invented, and the cycle edge's universal ('every afternoon detector is the fossil of a default that failed') contradicts the judge finding unless it admits fossils imported from another domain's wreck. Fudged figure's residence claim is also wrong in its strongest cases: where the judge publishes the threshold and the domain publishes the distribution, the pile-up just on the good side of the line is an afternoon's histogram from outside, which is how gamed hospital waits were actually caught.

items.item: Underwriter's question: the questions on an insurance application are the map of an outsider who loses money when wrong, so the form tells a stranger what kills enterprises of this kind before anyone inside will, the law firm's application asking about calendaring and never about legal skill, the restaurant's about the fryer and the floor, the trucker's about hours behind the wheel; it reads correctly wherever the insurer has paid claims in this domain for decades; it lies by omission, since the insurer maps only what is frequent, measurable, and uncorrelated, so the founder's death, the reputation, and the technology going obsolete are missing not because they matter less but because nobody will write the policy; the one detector runnable without entering the building.
items.why: Modality: 'what kills enterprises of this kind' promotes claim frequency to survival. Lawyers' liability forms ask about calendaring and conflicts because missed deadlines and conflicts produce paid claims; firms die of partner defection and client concentration, which no form asks about. The item also reads a different thing from the rest of the map (what hurts the domain, not what the domain treats as mattering), and that gap is itself a reading the item should name rather than hide.
items.repair: Underwriter's question: the questions on an insurance application are the map of an outsider who loses money when wrong, so the form tells a stranger what has produced paid claims in enterprises of this kind before anyone inside will, the law firm's application asking about calendaring and conflict checks and never about legal skill, the restaurant's about the fryer and the floor, the trucker's about hours behind the wheel; it reads correctly wherever the insurer has paid claims in this domain for decades, and it reads what hurts the domain rather than what the domain treats as mattering, so the gap between the form's questions and the domain's own drills and locks is itself a reading, the firm with no calendaring system that the form asks about twice; it lies by omission, since the insurer maps only what is frequent, measurable, litigable, and uncorrelated, so the founder's death, the reputation, the partner who walks with the clients, and the technology going obsolete are missing not because they matter less but because nobody will write the policy; the one detector runnable without entering the building.

items.item: Costly precision: within one domain the quantity measured most finely at the greatest expense is where the money or the danger lives, the pharmacist's milligram, the refinery's parts per million of sulphur, the airline's seat, the jeweler's hundredth of a carat; not domain-entry-keys' native tolerance, which marks a domain against other domains, but the comparison of quantities inside one; it lies where precision follows measurability rather than importance, since a web analytics stack logs clicks to the millisecond because logging is free while whether anyone bought is measured monthly and badly, so every precision must be weighted by what it costs to maintain, and it lies again as precision theater, the forecast to three decimals; an afternoon in the domain's own reports, if the cost of measuring can be learned.
items.why: The refinery's parts per million of sulphur is measured to the limit the fuel regulation names, so the item's second 'reads correctly' case is the judge's precision, the very lie the map's changed question discovered, and the item's lie clause (measurability, theater) does not contain it. Moving the refinery to the judge column yields a usable tell: a precision that stops exactly at a published limit reads the regulator.
items.repair: Costly precision: within one domain the quantity measured most finely at the greatest expense is where the money or the danger lives, the pharmacist's milligram, the airline's seat, the jeweler's hundredth of a carat, the foundry's degree at the pour; not domain-entry-keys' native tolerance, which marks a domain against other domains, but the comparison of quantities inside one; it lies where precision follows measurability rather than importance, since a web analytics stack logs clicks to the millisecond because logging is free while whether anyone bought is measured monthly and badly, so every precision must be weighted by what it costs to maintain; it lies again where the precision is the judge's, the refinery's parts per million of sulphur measured to the limit the fuel regulation names and no finer, so a precision that stops exactly at a published limit reads the regulator; and it lies as precision theater, the forecast to three decimals; an afternoon in the domain's own reports, if the cost of measuring can be learned and the limit it stops at can be looked up.

items.item: Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously, and aviation codifies it as the sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; a shift in the room, not a document, since no manual lists what is not funny.
items.why: Internal contradiction and modality: the item opens with aviation codifying the sterile cockpit and closes with 'no manual lists what is not funny'. The sterile cockpit rule is a regulator's rule written after crashes, so it is the fossil form of this detector, not its living form. The item also shares Preemption order's rank confound (first names become titles when the boss enters, load or no load), which the edge to Preemption order relies on register to correct; the tell that separates deference from load, whether the register holds after the powerful leave, belongs in the item.
items.repair: Register drop: the place where the domain's tone changes marks what it takes seriously; the general form is that jokes stop, first names become titles, and voices drop, so an hour in the break room lists what is never joked about; aviation's sterile cockpit below ten thousand feet, where nothing but the flight is spoken, is the one register drop written into a manual, and the regulator wrote it after wrecks, so it is the afternoon-readable fossil of this detector rather than its living form, which no manual lists; it lies in two directions, since a joke ban also marks a wound or a shame the domain carries rather than a load, and gallows cultures, the ward and the trench, joke hardest about exactly what matters most, so the detector reads the extremes of the humor distribution and not its absence alone; and it lies where the tone drops only while rank is in the room, which is deference and not load, the tell being whether the register holds after the powerful leave; a shift in the room, not a document.

items.item: Last cut: in a downturn the line cut last marks what the domain believes it is, the newspaper that cut the newsroom before the presses and the trucks and thereby confessed to being a distribution business, the airline that grounds routes before it sells the slots; it reads correctly across several rounds of cuts, since a single round cuts what is easiest; it lies where the protected line is protected by a contract, a pension, or a patron rather than a load, so the reading must be corrected by asking who could have cut it and did not; it needs a downturn, which is years, and a stranger who arrives in good times is shown the budget and never the order of cuts.
items.why: The 'reads correctly' case is the item's own lie case: newsrooms are cut before presses and trucks because presses sit under union contracts and trucks under leases while reporters are the variable cost, which the item's lie clause names two clauses later. The mechanism holds; the case must move to the lie column and a case where both lines were cuttable at will must carry the reading (associates cut before the partners' draw).
items.repair: Last cut: in a downturn the line cut last marks what the domain believes it is, the law firm that cut associates and then staff before it touched the partners' draw and thereby confessed to being a partnership before it was a practice, the software firm that cut sales before support and confessed to being its installed base; it reads correctly across several rounds of cuts, since a single round cuts what is easiest; it lies where the protected line is protected by a contract, a pension, a lease, or a patron rather than a load, the newspaper that cut the newsroom before the presses and the trucks, which reads as a confession of being a distribution business only once one has asked whether the presses were under a union contract and the trucks under a lease, so the reading must be corrected by asking who could have cut the protected line and did not; it needs a downturn, which is years, and a stranger who arrives in good times is shown the budget and never the order of cuts.

items.item: Fudged figure: the number the domain massages marks what its judge weighs and the domain does not, since nobody fudges a figure nobody reads, the hospital's wait time gamed by relabeling the corridor, the school's test scores, the sales pipeline inflated before the quarterly review; the fudge is a cost paid and a risk run, so it is a detector rather than theater, but a detector of a gap, reading the judge's importance on one side and the domain's contempt for it on the other; it lies where the fudge is vanity rather than defense, the headcount inflated for the founder's pride; visible only from inside, since the whole point of a fudge is that the outside cannot see it, and only over years, since one quarter's number is a number.
items.why: 'Visible only from inside, and only over years' is false in the item's own first example. Where the judge publishes the target and the domain publishes the distribution, bunching just on the good side of the line (waits ending at 3:59 under a four-hour target, grades clustering one mark above the pass) is an afternoon's histogram from outside, and that is how such gaming is in fact detected. The correction strengthens the map's own finding: the judge who makes the target legible makes the fudge legible with it, a second instance of the cycle. Keep it in the years band for the inside read and record the published-threshold exception in the seriation note.
items.repair: Fudged figure: the number the domain massages marks what its judge weighs and the domain does not, since nobody fudges a figure nobody reads, the hospital's wait time gamed by relabeling the corridor, the school's test scores, the sales pipeline inflated before the quarterly review; the fudge is a cost paid and a risk run, so it is a detector rather than theater, but a detector of a gap, reading the judge's importance on one side and the domain's contempt for it on the other; it lies where the fudge is vanity rather than defense, the headcount inflated for the founder's pride; from inside it takes years, since one quarter's number is a number, but wherever the judge publishes the line and the domain publishes the distribution, the pile-up just on the good side of the line, the waits that end at three hours fifty-nine, the grades that cluster one mark above the pass, is an afternoon's histogram from outside, so the judge who makes the target legible makes the fudge legible with it.

items.item: Halting absence: whose sick day stops the line marks the dependency the domain has never bought a spare for, the one clerk who knows the billing system, the one machinist who can run the old lathe, and the leave calendar carries the same reading, since the two people never allowed the same week off are the two the domain cannot be without; it reads correctly where the halt is in the work and not in the signatures; it lies where the absence halts work because only the absent one may sign, a bottleneck of authority rather than a load, and where the indispensable person has made herself so by hoarding, what status-conversions calls immunity by entanglement, so the halt marks a hostage rather than a load; the calendar is an afternoon's read, the halt itself needs someone to fall ill.
items.why: Tested as the closest neighbor of Panic price; separates on whether a substitute exists at any price (see neighbor_test). The leave-calendar tell (the two never allowed the same week off) is the map's best afternoon read of an event detector.

items.item: Panic price: what the domain pays any price for when short, the locum at triple rate, the part flown in, the plumber on Christmas, the spot-chartered ship, marks a dependency the budget never shows because at budget time the thing was cheap; it reads correctly where the panic recurs across years and the price is paid without argument; it lies as a one-time panic from bad planning of a thing that did not matter, the toner sent by courier, and it hides where the domain has grown ashamed of its panics and books them under another name; readable from the invoices of a bad month, which a stranger is not shown, and not from the budget, which the stranger is.
items.why: Tested against Halting absence; it reads the dependency that has a market at any price where Halting absence reads the one that has none, and a domain that takes a halt and books a locum next time has converted one to the other. Distinct in what it lets a stranger do: read invoices rather than the calendar.

items.item: Unmarked default: the most important thing in a domain may have no word, no drill, no lock, and no line in the budget because it has never been absent, the fish's water, the sailor's boat not sinking, the founder still coming in, the grid still up, and it is detectable only at failure, when the beached fish discovers water and, speculatively, the domain coins the word, writes the drill, and buys the spare within the season; it reads correctly in retrospect and never in advance, which is its whole limit; it lies where the unmarked thing is merely uninteresting rather than assumed, and only the removal tells the two apart; runnable from nowhere and at no time, except the stranger's one move, to ask a native what has never gone wrong, which natives answer with whatever they have never thought about.
items.why: Tempting to cut as a nonmember, since it reads no cost until the failure pays it; but the of-sentence names 'the failure itself' as a residence, the speculative within-the-season clause is marked, and it is the endpoint the seriation needs. It is the strangest member and should not be domesticated into 'assumptions'.

neighbor_test.left: Halting absence: whose sick day stops the line marks the dependency the domain has never bought a spare for, the one clerk who knows the billing system, the one machinist who can run the old lathe, and the leave calendar carries the same reading, since the two people never allowed the same week off are the two the domain cannot be without; it reads correctly where the halt is in the work and not in the signatures; it lies where the absence halts work because only the absent one may sign, a bottleneck of authority rather than a load, and where the indispensable person has made herself so by hoarding, what status-conversions calls immunity by entanglement, so the halt marks a hostage rather than a load; the calendar is an afternoon's read, the halt itself needs someone to fall ill.
neighbor_test.right: Panic price: what the domain pays any price for when short, the locum at triple rate, the part flown in, the plumber on Christmas, the spot-chartered ship, marks a dependency the budget never shows because at budget time the thing was cheap; it reads correctly where the panic recurs across years and the price is paid without argument; it lies as a one-time panic from bad planning of a thing that did not matter, the toner sent by courier, and it hides where the domain has grown ashamed of its panics and books them under another name; readable from the invoices of a bad month, which a stranger is not shown, and not from the budget, which the stranger is.
neighbor_test.separating_case: Both read a dependency the budget never showed and the domain never spared, and their example sets are nearly interchangeable (one clerk, one machinist; the locum, the plumber on Christmas). The one machinist who can run the old lathe: his absence halts the line and no price flies in a substitute, so Halting absence fires and Panic price is silent. The ward short a nurse on a bank holiday: the agency nurse is booked at triple rate and the line never halts, so Panic price fires and Halting absence is silent. They partition unspared dependencies by whether a market exists at any price, and a domain that takes a halt once and books a locum the next time has converted a Halting absence into a Panic price, which is a third passage the map could name. They separate; neither merges.

boundary_case: Biggest budget line: what the domain spends the most on marks what it treats as mattering. It passes the type's letter, since spending is a cost paid rather than a claim made, and it is the first thing a stranger with the accounts would try. It is out because the largest line is set by factor prices, not by the domain's valuation: payroll is the largest line in nearly every domain, the hospital spends more on nurses than on the blood bank and cannot be without either for an hour, and the ratio between lines reads the labour market rather than the load. The map already carries the corrected version as Panic price (the dependency the budget never shows because at budget time it was cheap) and Costly spare (a price paid for something idle, which factor prices cannot explain). Ruling: nonmember; the type's cost clause needs the cost to be discretionary at the domain's scale, which Costly spare, Costly precision, and Not on the menu each satisfy and the biggest line does not.

seriation.note: The endpoints are real (a form read outside the building; the failure itself) and the Not on the menu → First look hinge teaches something a ranking would not: the asked detector returns the judge's reason, the watched one cannot be performed for a stranger. The axis quietly folds two quantities, elapsed time and depth of access, and two items are where they part: Panic price is an afternoon of time but needs the invoices a stranger is not shown, and Fudged figure is years from inside but an afternoon from outside wherever the judge's threshold and the domain's distribution are both published. Do not reorder; add the published-threshold exception to the note as a second instance of the cycle (the judge's legibility carries the lie with it), and say once that residence means time and access together. The Firing offense → Last cut adjacency (one event to a series) holds.

edges.why: The antecedent is real and can fail (the default fails and the domain shrugs). The consequent's universal, 'every afternoon detector is the fossil of a default that failed', contradicts the map's own changed question, under which most afternoon detectors are imposed by a judge; Two-hand rule says so in its own text. The reconciliation is that the imposed rule is the fossil of another domain's wreck, imported by the judge, and whether the wreck was here or elsewhere is exactly Failed drill's discriminator (the drill the domain wrote can be failed; the imported one is run for the record). Adjacent to domain-entry-keys' Founding wreck; this label should say what it adds: legibility rather than rules as the fossil, and the judge as the import path.
edges.repair_label: If the default fails once, it is named, drilled, and given a second signature within the season, so the detector that could run only at failure becomes one that runs in an afternoon; every afternoon detector is then the fossil of a default that failed, either here or in the domain the judge was watching when the rule was written, and which of the two is the discriminator: the drill a domain wrote after its own wreck can be failed, the drill imported after someone else's is run for the record; the axis is a cycle that failure drives from its far end back to its near end, and the judge is how another domain's failure enters it.

edges.why: The fork's first branch holds (fudged and finely measured: the judge's). The second branch, 'measured finely at cost and never fudged: the domain's', fails on the refinery's sulphur, which is measured honestly to the regulation's limit under a real audit; not fudging proves the audit, not ownership. The separating tell is whether the precision is kept where no report goes, which gives a three-way fork.
edges.repair_label: Can discriminate: if the finely measured quantity is also the one the domain massages, the precision is for the judge; if it is measured as finely where no report is filed as where one is, it is the domain's own; a precision that is honest but stops exactly at the report's limit is the judge's under a real audit, and costly precision alone cannot tell the three apart.

edges.why: The label uses register to correct preemption's rank confound, but register has the same confound: voices drop and titles come out when the boss enters, load or no load, and the item's own 'first names become titles' is a rank response. As written the correction can fail silently. It survives only where the register was read out of the powerful's earshot.
edges.repair_label: If what preempts the meeting also drops the register in a room the preempting rank never enters, the preemption was for the load; if the meeting is cancelled and the tone drops only where the rank can hear it, both detectors read the hierarchy and neither corrects the other; the register reading corrects the preemption reading only where it was taken out of the powerful's earshot.

edges.why: Modality: 'a dependency insurance cannot price' overclaims; key-person and business-interruption cover exist. What the edge can say is that no policy on file priced it.
edges.repair_label: If the domain pays any price at the last minute for something the underwriter never asked about, the panic price reads a dependency no policy on file priced, and the two detectors complement rather than confirm: the form maps the insurable, the invoice maps the rest.

edges.why: Tried to break it with the airline simulator check, which is scored, failed, and career-ending on a pattern; but no airline fires on a first failed check, it retrains, which is the domain designing around exactly this incompatibility. The counterexample confirms the edge; the length of the retraining path between the failed drill and the door is a further reading the repairer may leave as a seed.

modality_problems: Underwriter's question: 'what kills enterprises of this kind' promotes paid-claim frequency to survival; the form reads what produces claims.

Register drop: the sterile cockpit is presented as the domain codifying its own register, but it is a regulator's rule written after crashes, and the item's closing clause ('no manual lists what is not funny') contradicts its opening.
Costly precision: the refinery's parts per million of sulphur is the fuel regulation's precision, offered as the domain's own.
Last cut: the newspaper's presses and trucks are asserted as a confession of identity while the item's own lie clause (contract, lease) applies to them.
Fudged figure: 'visible only from inside' is false where the judge's threshold and the domain's distribution are both published; threshold bunching is an outside afternoon read.

Edge Unmarked default → Failed drill: 'every afternoon detector is the fossil of a default that failed' is a universal that the map's own judge-imposed cases contradict unless imported fossils are admitted.
Edge Panic price → Underwriter's question: 'a dependency insurance cannot price' should be 'no policy on file priced'.
Otherwise the register is honest: the within-the-season clause is marked speculative in the item, the mode, the boundary claim, and the ledger, and the cases are declared simplified.
duplication: No item or the whole duplicates a grown list. Adjacencies are declared in-item where they matter (First look vs Kept tell, Costly precision vs Native tolerance, Firing offense vs Fatal class, Reorg survivor vs ghost-leverages, Halting absence vs status-conversions' immunity by entanglement). One adjacency is declared only in the ledger and should be in the record: the cycle edge is domain-entry-keys' Founding wreck read from the detector's side, and what it adds (legibility rather than rules as the fossil; the judge as the path by which another domain's wreck arrives here) belongs in the repaired edge label.
best_unresolved_seed: The distribution around the judge's line as a detector in its own right: wherever a judge publishes a threshold and the domain publishes what it measures, the shape of the pile-up at the line (bunching just above it, the hole just below it, the smoothness where nobody cares) reads the judge's weight and the domain's contempt in one afternoon from outside, and it generalizes past figures to any scored thing, drill scores, audit findings, cut lines. The map points at it through Fudged figure and never names it; a second seed is the third passage the neighbor test exposed, a Halting absence converting into a Panic price the first time the domain finds a locum, alongside the two conversions (default → drill, absence → spare) the map already draws.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items whose showcase cases sat in the map's own judge column (the sterile cockpit, the refinery's sulphur, the newspaper's presses, the underwriter's 'what kills', the fudge's residence) and relabeling four edges so the cycle admits imported fossils, the precision fork survives an honest audit, and the register discriminator survives rank; no item cut.
